svg.title: Agile Planner - LLMOps Architecture
svg.desc: Technology and signal flow: Jira CSV to Python ingestion, MongoDB and SQLite; Ollama embeddings; React and TypeScript user interface; FastAPI Sprint Agent with metadata, retrieval and analysis tools; configurable Ollama, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI and Gemini connections; versioned prompt and golden dataset catalogs, Ragas evaluation, human activation, monitoring and optional Langfuse export.

g.text: Scope + prompt → plan → tools → verified synthesis
Choose one configured connection per run
Replay agent · compare one or two models
Human feedback → revise prompts / golden data → evaluate again
Dashed arrows: optional export / human feedback. Models and embeddings are configured independently.
Read-only Jira snapshot · Attachment references only · Human-controlled prompt activation
